CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[AG_MV_TRANSACTION_pros] (@T_ID int OUTPUT, @DATE dateTIME NULL, @AG_ID_FROM int NULL, @AG_ID_TO int NULL, @TITLE nvarchar(2500) NULL, @ABOUT nvarchar(Max) NULL, @USER_ID int NULL, --@is_Void int = NULL, @VALUE numeric(18,3), @Process VARCHAR(20) ) AS
BEGIN IF @Process = 'DELETE' BEGIN UPDATE dbo.AG_MV_TRANSACTION SET is_Void = 1 WHERE T_ID = @T_ID --DELETE FROM dbo.AG_MV_TRANSACTION -- WHERE T_ID = @T_ID RETURN 1 END IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AG_MV_TRANSACTION WHERE T_ID = @T_ID ) BEGIN UPDATE dbo.AG_MV_TRANSACTION SET [DATE] = @DATE, [AG_ID_FROM] = @AG_ID_FROM, [AG_ID_TO] = @AG_ID_TO, [TITLE] = @TITLE, [ABOUT] = @ABOUT, [USER_ID] = @USER_ID, -- [is_Void] = @is_Void, [VALUE] = @VALUE WHERE T_ID = @T_ID RETURN 1 END ELSE BEGIN
exec @T_ID = AA_GET_MAX_ID 'AG_MV_TRANSACTION'
INSERT INTO dbo.AG_MV_TRANSACTION ( [T_ID], [DATE], [AG_ID_FROM], [AG_ID_TO], [TITLE], [ABOUT], [USER_ID], [BsType_ID], [VALUE]) SELECT @T_ID,@DATE, @AG_ID_FROM, @AG_ID_TO, @TITLE, @ABOUT, @USER_ID, 40, @VALUE RETURN 1 END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Treasury_BalanceMV_insert] @T_ID int Output ,
@Date datetime, @Debit Numeric(18, 2) = NULL, @Credit Numeric(18, 2) = NULL, @Balance Numeric(18, 2) = 0, @About nvarchar(MAX) = NULL, @User_ID int, --------------------------------------- @Tr_Type_ID int = NULL, @Tr_ID int = NULL, @Bank_Name nvarchar(100) = NULL, @CheckNum nvarchar(100) = NULL, @isFirst_Time int = 0
AS --declare @Time Time(0) = CONVERT(time, GETUTCDATE())
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION EXEC @T_ID = [AA_GET_MAX_Treasury_Balance_MV] INSERT INTO [dbo].[Treasury_Balance_MV] ([T_ID] ,[AGBalance_T_ID] ,[Tran_ID] ,[date] ,[Tr_ID] ,[notice_move] ,[Bank_Name] ,[CheckNum] ,[Debit] ,[Credit] ,[Balance] ,[Tr_Type_ID] ,[isTran_From] ,[isTran_To] ,[User_ID] ,[isVoid] ,[isFirst_Time]) Values (@T_ID,NULL,NULL,@Date,@Tr_ID,@About,@Bank_Name,@CheckNum,@Debit,@Credit,@Balance,@Tr_Type_ID,NULL,NULL,@User_ID,0,@isFirst_Time)
COMMIT
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 print 'DB ERROR ! __ [Treasury_BalanceMV_insert]' ROLLBACK END CATCH

Definitions.name: Treasury_BalanceMV_isVoid
Definitions.Definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Treasury_BalanceMV_isVoid] @T_ID int AS Declare @Tr_ID int = NULL
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION DECLARE @TRAN_ID INT
SELECT @TRAN_ID = TRAN_ID FROM Treasury_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID =@T_ID
IF @TRAN_ID IS NULL BEGIN UPDATE Treasury_Balance_MV SET isVoid = 1 WHERE T_ID = @T_ID END ELSE BEGIN UPDATE Treasury_Balance_MV SET isVoid = 1 WHERE TRAN_ID = @TRAN_ID END
COMMIT END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 print 'DB ERROR ! __ [Treasury_BalanceMV_isVoid]' ROLLBACK END CATCH

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Treasury_BalanceMV_Trans_isVoid] @Tran_ID int AS Declare @Tr_ID int = NULL
